shapeSummary: A 48 x 14 x 48 mm rectangular controller housing (X by Y by Z), with Y as the 14 mm height. The bottom sits at Y=0 and the part is centered in X and Z. Four 4.2 mm through holes run along Y at (±20, ±20) mm in the XZ plane.
warnings: Overall size is estimated from the photo, and no dimensions were verified.
The analysis lists the 14 mm thickness along Z. It was mapped to Y so the bottom sits at Y=0 as the rules require, and the hole axes were mapped to Y to match.
The 40 mm hole spacing and 4.2 mm hole diameter are assumptions based on the M4 hardware in the kit.
Omitted the wires, connectors (XT30, bullet, servo header), status LED, labels, and the corner and edge chamfers or bevels on the housing.
Omitted the underside fins or lower housing step, because their dimensions are uncertain.
